subject: wrangler
detail: Wrangler can automatically provision Flagship, Dispatch Namespaces and Queues when you deploy your Worker, without you having to create them ahead of time.

test.error: FAIL: a Queue producer binding without a queue name was rejected

source.quote: Wrangler can automatically provision resources for you when you deploy your Worker without you having to create them ahead of time. This currently works for the following resources: KV, R2, D1, Flagship, AI Search, Agent Memory, Dispatch Namespaces and Queues.
